title: Implement binary search
prompt: Create `search.js` (CommonJS) exporting `binarySearch(sortedArr, target)` that returns the INDEX of `target` in the ascending-sorted array `sortedArr`, or -1 if absent. It must run in O(log n) (iterative or recursive binary search — do NOT use Array.prototype.indexOf). The test file `verify.test.js` is present and must pass via `node --test verify.test.js`. Do NOT modify the test file.
